notes.title: What's Next For The Never Ending Game
notes.notes: Hello everybody, I haven't been to good as far as updating you guys on what's next for the never ending game. I am happy to announce that multiplayer is coming soon to The never ending game!!!! expect this update somewhere around the end of February. Thank you and have a great day!

notes.title: The Never Ending Game Update
notes.notes: Hello everyone The creator of The Never Ending Game here, and I wanted to let you know that the UI artwork has been improved to look more pleasing. I hope you all have Very happy holidays and a happy new year.

notes.title: The Never Ending game Delay
notes.notes: Hi everyone i am the creator of The Never Ending Game and i just wanted to let you know that The Never Ending Game is going to have a slight delay in releasing. the new release date is planned on December 15 due to a game breaking bug. i am getting it done as soon as possible thank you for your patience and i hope you will understand. Thank you everyone!
